描述_ZN: The tile pawn "Yongshi Jiafu", Western Han dynasty, 15.7 cm in diameter.　　A Western Han Dynasty tile, made of pottery. On the face of the tile, the four characters "YONG SHOU JIA FU" are raised and written in Miao seal script. Miao seal script is sometimes found on bronze vessels and seals of the Han Dynasty. The poem reads: "I have inherited the Emperor's bright virtue, and I have taught him the image of the mountain. The cloud is given to the people, and they are forever blessed. Cheng Rong's constant, the emperor's brightness. The lower people are at peace and happy, and receive blessings without bounds." The phrase "to receive blessings forever" is a prayer for blessings.　　Recorded text: Eternal blessing.
